suitability.rationale: Directly proposes recombinant MAP3K7 biochemical inhibition with an ADP readout and interference controls, while limiting cellular and causal conclusions.
response_quotes: Do not infer cellular target engagement from this assay.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Coherent preparation, reaction, ATP depletion, ADP detection and analysis outline with appropriate intended controls. Essential operational parameters and validation thresholds remain unresolved; this is not yet an executable supported procedure.
response_quotes: Stop the kinase reaction and deplete residual ATP, perform the ADP detection reaction, and measure luminescence.
Enzyme construct, activation requirements, substrate, ATP and enzyme concentrations, reaction time, temperature, vehicle fraction, and detection timings remain unresolved.

numerical_soundness.rationale: Internally consistent and explicitly provisional dilution design. Broad coverage alone gives limited contextual justification for choosing a 100 uM top and ten points; supplied measurements are not used to justify these particular settings. No arithmetic contradiction or fabricated support is evident.
response_quotes: Prepare CHEMBL1077979 over a provisional 10-point, 3-fold dilution series from 100 uM, with three independent replicates.
The numeric concentration-series and replication settings are provisional assumptions, not sourced measurements.

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of ADP-Glo with the unresolved MAP3K7 construct, activation requirements and substrate.
Comparability of the retained assay formats with the proposed assay.
Compound solubility, vehicle tolerance and validated operating conditions are not supplied.
assumption_handling: Clearly labels numerical choices provisional and operational conditions unresolved. Correctly avoids transferring other compounds potency values or assay-specific preincubation and does not claim the supplied examples validate ADP-Glo.

numeric_check.notes: Ten points span 100 to 0.005080526342529086 uM (5.080526342529086 nM). No explicit minimum or list contradicts this. Three replicates are called independent, though their experimental organization remains unspecified.

review_reason: Assay compatibility and essential operating parameters require domain validation; the provisional concentration range has limited contextual justification.
